evidence.text: Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level.
evidence.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses

milestones.title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement
milestones.why: 提出“物理递归自我改进”，把这一概念扩展到由物理经验驱动的机器人能力与改进流程更新。
milestones.workTitle: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement

evidence.text: This study investigates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), in which physical experience guides lasting updates to both a robot's capabilities and its improvement procedure, making subsequent improvement more effective across tasks.
evidence.title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement

evidence.text: We introduce EmbodiRSI, an agentic system for recursive self-improvement (RSI) in a real-to-sim-to-real setting, where task-specific simulations are constructed from target deployment scenarios and used as low-cost environments for iterative policy improvement before transfer back to the physical world.
evidence.title: EmbodiRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Data-Efficient Robot Adaptation

evidence.text: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement.
evidence.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy

milestones.title: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion: The Evaluation Evidence Behind Recursive Self-Improvement Claims
milestones.why: 质疑现有递归自我改进论断的评估证据，指出这类论断往往由作者自选标准来判定。
milestones.workTitle: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion: The Evaluation Evidence Behind Recursive Self-Improvement Claims

evidence.text: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) promises AI systems, such as self-evolving LLM agents, that become better at producing further improvements.
evidence.title: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion: The Evaluation Evidence Behind Recursive Self-Improvement Claims

evidence.text: Claims of recursive self-improvement (RSI) are usually judged against criteria chosen by their authors.
evidence.title: Level-4 Bounded Recursive Self-Improvement under a Published Definition: A Preregistered Test of a Self-Referential Improvement Mechanism
